m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I sought a way out of the forest, but ended up trapped in this clearing. Are the Younglings safe?
Good work! I'll head home and check on them there! Thank you for your help!
There is little we can do before Xibalba's wrath but cling together as a people. You have done us a great service this day.
Magician, I have a great favor to ask of you, one that you are uniquely suited for.
Several of our Younglings have gotten lost in Cloudburst Forest, likely hiding from Shadow Weavers and Splinter Wings.
Worse yet, their Scout Master's courage must have fled, for we have heard no word from him.
I cannot venture into the forest without risking Zultun Dock. But I sense you could bring them home to safety. Please find them!
Can you seek out our missing Younglings and their Scout Master in the Cloudburst Forest and send them home?
